a.lede: After saying that Nvidia's new CEO should come "outside the company," U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent now argues that former chief Jensen Huang "is on the outside," paving the way for a return following President Trump's declaration of his "hope" that Huang will be back.
a.title: President Trump says Nvidia board rehiring Jensen Huang would be best for the company and US

b.lede: Jensen Huang comes back, numbers go up. Maybe the reason behind the CEO’s return is just that simple?
b.title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
